authority_snapshot.role: Local fixed restore snapshot, opened read-only (mode=ro); the queue file was not re-read, the production pointer was neither locked nor refreshed, and no count or commit from the earlier jep238 batch is reused anywhere in this record.

actual_schema_note: Schema read from PRAGMA table_info and recorded in runs/6_88/neighbor_queries_6_88.json; the searched text is lower(title || ' ' || difficulty_reason || ' ' || claim_key).

metadata_queries.name: subdivision_of_edges
metadata_queries.where: (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%subdivision%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%subdivide%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%subdivided%')

metadata_queries.name: exponential_tail_of_a_distribution
metadata_queries.where: (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%exponential tail%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%heavy-tailed%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%heavy tail%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%stretched exponential%')

metadata_queries.name: anchored_expansion_or_anchored_isoperimetry
metadata_queries.where: (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%anchored expansion%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%anchored isoperimetric%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%anchored%' AND lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%isoperimetr%')

metadata_queries.name: binary_tree_boundary_or_level_counts
metadata_queries.where: (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%binary tree%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%binary trees%') AND (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%boundary%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%level%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%isoperimetr%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%expansion%')

query_bucket_size_note: The four returned row sets total 73 rows over 73 unique ids, so no id is returned by two buckets; every bucket returned its full count under LIMIT 60 and nothing is reachable only through an ordering cut. The third bucket (anchored expansion or anchored isoperimetry) returns 0 over the whole 22819-problem snapshot.
line_count_convention_note: One convention only: lines are counted with str.splitlines() on the retained tex, which is what the export helper does, and the two agree at 604 for the four read units. The char totals are len(tex_content) summed over the same four units (34756), i.e. the whole retained body of each unit, so the recorded whole-read ranges [1, n_lines] cover every retained character of all four and no unit is partially read.
